gaps.current_state: The repository commits ZERO Mall@Reds store rows. mall_id f4a2c1b3 appears only in a QA checklist, smoke tests, and an env example. seed.sql seeds 8 other malls, none is Mall@Reds.
gaps.required_state: A complete, trustworthy Mall@Reds store directory (every trading store: name, category, shop number, floor, trading hours, phone).
gaps.recommended_next_action: Acquire the full Mall@Reds tenant list from the official directory (mallatreds.co.za) and on-site/phone verification; stage it through the existing review workflow.

gaps.current_state: Only one Mall@Reds store ('Game') has a committed name; four others exist only as unmerged CSV placeholders with no store name, shop number, floor, phone, or hours.
gaps.required_state: Each store has a shop number, floor, trading hours, and phone captured with provenance.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Field-verify shop numbers/floors/hours per store; do not infer from product brands.

gaps.current_state: Mall@Reds store/product WIP lives on two UNMERGED branches (mallreds-*-v1) and is not on the base branch; it risks being lost or applied without review.
gaps.required_state: WIP is either merged through review or explicitly retired; a single source of truth for Mall@Reds acquisition state.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Triage the two mallreds-* branches: promote the reusable scripts/source-pack template, discard stale placeholders.

gaps.current_state: Zero committed, evidence-backed Mall@Reds products. The only Mall@Reds product data in git is 37 unmerged CSV rows (2 claim verification, 26 marked DO-NOT-APPLY). The 110 committed seed products are all DEMO-grade and for other malls.
gaps.required_state: Substantial real, multi-retailer, evidence-backed product coverage for Mall@Reds visible to the shopper.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Capture real prices/offers per store (phone/website/store-visit evidence) and publish through a governed workflow.

gaps.current_state: The products table has NO image_url, sku, or gtin columns at all. Zero image/SKU/GTIN coverage is structurally impossible to store.
gaps.required_state: Products can carry an image, a SKU/model, and ideally a GTIN for reliable identity and shopper trust.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Plan an additive schema change (image_url, gtin/sku) — deferred out of this audit sprint.

gaps.current_state: The classic '43-inch TV under R5000' demo has NO committed backing for Mall@Reds (0 seed products for the mall; 0 43-inch TVs in seed). Whether the demo works depends entirely on unaudited live-DB rows.
gaps.required_state: At least one real, verified, in-budget 43-inch TV offer at a real Mall@Reds electronics store, shown with evidence.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Verify a real Game (or equivalent) 43-inch TV price at Mall@Reds and publish with evidence.

gaps.current_state: There is no product-linked evidence/observation table with (source, observed_at, valid_to, evidence_url) and a NOT NULL FK. Provenance is fragmented: inline single-slot fields on products (data_source/verified_by free text) plus separate staging queues (price_correction_reports, mall_source_findings) that never write back to products.
gaps.required_state: Every published price/availability traces to a durable, product-linked evidence record with source and timestamp.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Design an additive price-observation/evidence entity (deferred from this audit) and route acquisition through it.

gaps.current_state: No publication gate for products: a product is live the instant it is inserted. data_quality_status='demo' is the only signal separating untrusted rows, and it does not restrict shopper visibility.
gaps.required_state: A staging-vs-published distinction so only reviewed, evidence-backed offers reach shoppers.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Introduce a review/publication status on the shopper-facing offer entity (deferred; design first).

gaps.current_state: The shopper path applies NO evidence gate. Products are returned by name ILIKE + shop_id-in-mall + optional price; trust/verification only affects ranking and a badge. A demo, unverified TV is fully eligible and can be the 'Best pick'.
gaps.required_state: Governed eligibility: only evidence-backed, sufficiently-fresh offers are shown; unverified data is excluded or clearly gated, not merely badged.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Add a governed-eligibility filter (e.g. getShopperEligibleOffers) between the products query and the shopper.

gaps.current_state: No freshness gate. price_verified_at only drives a 7-day expiry BADGE; stale prices are still returned and rankable. The assistant path also does not filter in_stock (SearchPage does).
gaps.required_state: Stale prices are excluded or explicitly flagged as unverified; availability is honestly represented.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Add a recency threshold to the shopper eligibility filter; unify in_stock handling across assistant and search.

gaps.current_state: 'Under R5,000' typed in prose is NOT parsed into the SQL price filter by AssistantPage; the cap relies on the LLM extracting budget into the tool call. If the LLM omits it, over-budget items are only scored down.
gaps.required_state: Deterministic budget/spec parsing so price and size constraints are reliably enforced regardless of LLM behavior.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Add deterministic query parsing for budget and size tokens before/alongside the LLM.

gaps.current_state: Mall@Reds has ZERO committed map nodes, edges, and store-node links. Routing is entirely contingent on live-DB mall_nodes.linked_shop_id being populated; the smoke test has an explicit '0 steps / no matching node' fallback branch.
gaps.required_state: A real Mall@Reds node/edge graph with entrances, vertical transitions, and every store linked to a node, so routes actually build.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Build the Mall@Reds graph (from a real floor plan) and populate linked_shop_id for every store.

gaps.current_state: There is NO real indoor positioning (no BLE/Wi-Fi/UWB/compass/QR/NFC/camera). GPS is outdoor mall-selection only. The map shows a hardcoded 'GPS' badge and 'Tracking' label with nothing behind them.
gaps.required_state: An honest positioning approach: either a practical fixed-start + manual-advance model presented truthfully, or a real positioning input — with UI that does not overstate capability.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Decide and implement an honest positioning UX (e.g. scan-to-locate at entrances, or explicit 'start from entrance'); remove the misleading GPS/Tracking badges.

gaps.current_state: Map geometry is synthetic (real y_coordinate ignored; edge distances estimated). Special node types (escalator/lift/stairs/parking) are stored but never rendered. Offline maps do not work (SW bypasses Supabase).
gaps.required_state: Map geometry reflects the real floor plan; vertical-transition and parking nodes are visible; core map works offline in-mall.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Use real coordinates from the floor plan; add glyphs for vertical nodes; cache the mall graph for offline.

gaps.current_state: Two divergent routing implementations (edge function vs backend service) persist route_steps/destination_shop_ids in incompatible JSONB formats (stringified vs native array); a dead ternary hides unit numbers; current_anchor_node_id is read but never written.
gaps.required_state: A single routing implementation with consistent persistence and working instruction text.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Consolidate to one routing path and fix the persistence-format mismatch and dead code.

gaps.current_state: No retailer (chain) entity and no canonical-product/offer entity. A product is copied per mall (same SKU is a distinct row per branch; e.g. Samsung Galaxy S24 duplicated 7+ times in seed). Retailer identity is only an unnormalized shops.name string.
gaps.required_state: canonical product -> retailer -> retailer offer -> branch -> mall, so one national offer supports many branches without duplication.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Design an additive retailer/canonical-offer model (deferred from this audit). Do NOT create the migration in this sprint.

gaps.current_state: Branch availability is a two-state products.in_stock boolean with no UNKNOWN state and no availability_observed_at; all demo rows hardcode true, so unverified stock is indistinguishable from genuinely-in-stock. Base products table DDL is not even in the repo (created in dashboard), so in_stock nullability is unconfirmed.
gaps.required_state: Branch availability can be UNKNOWN (not falsely shown as live stock) and carries an observed_at timestamp.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Model tri-state availability with a timestamp (deferred design); never present unknown stock as live.

gaps.current_state: Core relationships shops.mall_id -> malls, products.shop_id -> shops, products.mall_id -> malls are NOT declared as foreign keys in any migration (base tables live only in the dashboard). FK discipline is inconsistent (003 stores product_id with no FK by design).
gaps.required_state: Explicit, enforced foreign keys for the core geo/retail relationships.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Capture the true dashboard schema into a migration and add the missing FKs (deferred; design first).

gaps.current_state: This audit cannot read the live Supabase project, so the TRUE current state of Mall@Reds stores/products/nodes is unknown. All 'reality' claims about the running app are unverifiable from the repo.
gaps.required_state: A read-only, safe export of the live Mall@Reds stores/products/nodes so the reality proof can be measured against actual data.
gaps.recommended_next_action: Provide a read-only DB snapshot/export (service-role, non-destructive) of mall_id f4a2c1b3 rows for a follow-up audit.
